scope: Private three-file inactive-state/plan/intent publication at seven boundaries; plan hash and displacement-name binding; exact frozen history and authority/coordination identities; non-creating metadata reopening under existing writer/runtime leases. Both Darwin unit-test jobs and guarded root-copy fixtures passed at this exact source. Metadata fixtures explicitly use synthetic payload entries; this does not establish filesystem reconciliation or deletion authorization.
